title: AceMath: Advancing Frontier Math Reasoning with Post-Training and Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Zihan Liu、Yang Chen、Mohammad Shoeybi、Bryan Catanzaro、Wei Ping
paper_type_zh: 分阶段数学指令数据发布与后训练研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建大规模数学监督微调混合，或比较题目演化、答案交叉核对与分阶段课程。
one_line: AceMath releases 2.26M, 1.63M, and 1.66M-row SFT stages for general-to-math post-training with explicit synthesis and filtering controls.
AceMath 发布三阶段通用到数学监督微调数据，以统一教师解答、跨模型答案核对和数据筛选支撑后训练。
why: It makes a strong general-before-math SFT curriculum and its synthetic-data quality decisions reusable instead of reporting only the final models.
inclusion_reason: AceMath releases the complete staged supervision used by its math SFT models and directly tests prompt synthesis, answer cross-checking, data selection, and general-before-math training choices.

title: Problem
问题
html:
AceMath asks how to turn a math-specialized base model into a strong instruction follower without sacrificing its mathematical competence, and which data choices make that post-training reliable. The primary source is Findings of ACL 2025, published July 2025, and the decision boundary is a three-file SFT release rather than the reward-model corpus reported elsewhere in the same paper.

The relevant data object is a staged collection of role-content prompts and answer targets: code and math establish the first general stage, code, math, and general-domain instructions rebalance the second, and a selected math corpus performs the final specialization. Its evaluation surface is greedy pass@1 on seven math benchmarks plus controlled removals of synthetic data, cross-checking, and general SFT, making it directly relevant to reusable instruction, demonstration, and rationale data.

L4 facts: official paper Findings of ACL 2025, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.findings-acl.206; official non-gated dataset nvidia/AceMath-Instruct-Training-Data; exact split counts 2,261,687, 1,634,573, and 1,661,094; role-content messages plus answer schema, construction, filtering, decontamination, staged consumers, ablations, non-commercial terms, and reuse risks verified.

AceMath 研究如何把数学专用基础模型训练成兼具指令遵循能力与数学能力的模型，以及哪些数据选择能让后训练更可靠。主来源是 2025 年 7 月发表的 ACL Findings 论文，本卡的判定对象是三份监督微调文件，而不是同一论文另行发布的奖励模型语料。

核心数据对象是分阶段的角色消息与答案目标：第一阶段以代码和数学建立能力，第二阶段加入通用指令并重新混合，最后用筛选后的数学语料专门化。评测覆盖七个数学基准的贪心解码结果，以及去掉合成数据、答案核对或通用阶段的受控比较，因此它直接属于可复用的指令、示范与推理数据。

L4 事实：正式来源为 ACL Findings 2025，编号为 10.18653/v1/2025.findings-acl.206；官方数据集无需申请即可读取；三份文件分别有 2,261,687、1,634,573 和 1,661,094 条记录；字段、构造、筛选、去污染、训练消费者、消融、非商业条款与复用风险均已核对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AceMath's reusable contribution is not merely a large math corpus: it records a general-before-math curriculum in three exact releases, replaces heterogeneous source answers with consistent model-written responses, enriches prompts through controlled evolution, and reserves cross-model final-answer agreement for higher-quality stages. The release fits instruction and rationale data because models consume static prompt-answer demonstrations; the reward-model pairs and RewardBench are related but separate artifacts.

Google Scholar citations: 76（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=AceMath%3A+Advancing+Frontier+Math+Reasoning+with+Post-Training+and+Reward+Modeling&author=Zihan+Liu&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: AceMath-Instruct-Training-Data. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/AceMath-Instruct-Training-Data. Scale: 2,261,687 general stage-1 rows, 1,634,573 general stage-2 rows, and 1,661,094 math-SFT rows; stages reuse selected material and are not unique-example totals. Record form: messages is a list of role-content objects and answer is a string; the official card shows the user prompt in messages and the target separately. File / storage format: three public Parquet files in one default configuration. Domains / languages: English mathematics from grade school through Olympiad and college level, code, and general instruction following. Construction and filtering: deduplicate prompts, synthesize about one million math prompts, generate unified responses, filter format, length and repetition, cross-check selected final answers, and remove evaluation overlaps. License / access constraints: non-gated CC-BY-NC-4.0 for non-commercial use, additionally subject to OpenAI terms for OpenAI-generated portions and upstream-source terms. Intended use: staged SFT, math distillation, data-selection ablations, and evaluation of general-to-domain curricula.

AceMath 的可复用贡献不是单纯堆叠数学样本，而是把先通用、后数学的课程固定成三份精确文件；它用统一教师重写异构来源的回答，以受控题目演化扩展提示，并只在高质量阶段使用跨模型最终答案一致性。模型训练消费的是静态题目与解答示范，因此归入指令与推理数据；奖励模型配对和奖励基准是同论文中的独立对象。

Google Scholar 引用数：76（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=AceMath%3A+Advancing+Frontier+Math+Reasoning+with+Post-Training+and+Reward+Modeling&author=Zihan+Liu&hl=en）

开放状态：公开且无需申请。数据集名称：AceMath 指令训练数据。官方地址见元数据。规模：通用第一阶段 2,261,687 条，通用第二阶段 1,634,573 条，数学阶段 1,661,094 条；阶段之间有意复用部分材料，不能相加当作唯一样本数。记录由角色与内容消息列表以及独立答案字符串组成。存储为默认配置中的三份公开文件。领域包括英文数学、代码和通用指令。构造过程包括去重、合成约一百万道数学题、统一生成、格式与长度筛选、重复检测、答案交叉核对和评测去污染。许可为署名非商业，并受生成服务与上游来源条款约束。适用于分阶段监督微调、数学蒸馏、数据选择消融和课程评估。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1: Input: Open math, code, and general instruction datasets, including NuminaMath, OrcaMathWordProblems, MathInstruct, MetaMathQA, ShareGPT, and code-instruction sources. Operation: Normalize prompts, remove exact duplicates after lowercasing, and retain the remaining variety rather than scoring all prompts with a separate quality model. Output and transition: More than 1.3M initial math prompts plus code and general prompt pools move to response construction. Check / stop rule: A duplicate prompt is removed; source terms and source-level identifiers must be reconstructed before downstream redistribution.

Step 2: Input: NuminaMath seeds and GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18. Operation: Apply in-breadth and in-depth evolution to create new, solvable math questions while excluding a constraint-adding evolution branch that often made questions unsolvable. Output and transition: About one million selected synthetic prompts join the initial math pool, for more than 2.3M math prompts before response filtering. Check / stop rule: Remove synthetic prompts over 300 words and filter about 500K noisy, overlong, or likely unsolvable candidates.

Step 3: Input: The collected prompts, Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct, and GPT-4o-mini. Operation: Generate one step-by-step Qwen solution with a boxed final answer for each math prompt; generate consistent responses for code and general prompts with GPT-4o-mini. Output and transition: About 2.3M math responses, 1.2M code responses, and 0.7M general-domain responses enter structural and quality filters. Check / stop rule: Reject missing required structure, responses longer than 2,500 words, unfinished generations, and detected repetitive strings.

Step 4: Input: Qwen math solutions, two independent GPT-4o-mini solutions per selected prompt, and benchmark test questions. Operation: Compare extracted final answers across teachers and run normalized 13-gram plus longest-common-subsequence overlap checks against evaluations. Output and transition: An 800K cross-checked high-quality math subset and decontaminated pools feed the staged SFT mixture. Check / stop rule: Keep a cross-checked item only when the two GPT-4o-mini answers agree with Qwen; remove math prompts with a 13-gram match and over-60% longest common subsequence.

Step 5: Input: The filtered pools and Qwen2.5-Math base models at 1.5B, 7B, and 72B. Operation: Train first on 2,261,687 code-and-math rows, continue on 1,634,573 mixed rows, then perform math-specific SFT on 1,661,094 rows. Output and transition: AceMath-Instruct checkpoints are evaluated on seven math benchmarks and compared with data and curriculum ablations. Check / stop rule: Pin all three Parquet revisions, teacher versions, overlap tests, chat serialization, one-epoch optimizer settings, and benchmark scripts before attributing gains to a data choice.

步骤一： 输入：公开数学、代码与通用指令来源。 操作：规范化提示，转成小写后删除完全重复项，并保留其余多样性。 输出与流转：超过 130 万道初始数学题以及代码、通用提示进入回答构造。 检查与停止：重复提示被删除；再分发前还需补回来源标识并审核上游条款。

步骤二： 输入：数学种子题与轻量教师模型。 操作：使用广度演化和深度演化生成新题，并排除容易制造不可解问题的附加约束分支。 输出与流转：约一百万道合成题与初始题合并，形成超过 230 万道候选数学提示。 检查与停止：删除超过三百词的合成题，并筛掉约五十万条噪声、过长或疑似不可解候选。

步骤三： 输入：候选提示、数学教师和通用教师。 操作：数学教师为每题生成一份分步解答与框选答案，通用教师生成代码和通用领域回答。 输出与流转：约 230 万份数学回答、120 万份代码回答和 70 万份通用回答进入结构筛选。 检查与停止：缺少规定结构、超过两千五百词、未完成或出现重复字符串的回答被删除。

步骤四： 输入：数学教师答案、每题两份独立通用教师答案和评测题。 操作：提取并比较最终答案，同时执行规范化片段重合和最长公共子序列检查。 输出与流转：八十万条交叉核对的高质量数学样本与去污染语料进入分阶段混合。 检查与停止：三份最终答案一致才进入高质量子集；与评测存在规定重合的题目被移除。

步骤五： 输入：筛选语料与三个规模的数学基础模型。 操作：依次使用代码数学阶段、通用混合阶段和数学专门阶段训练。 输出与流转：得到系列指令模型，并在七个数学基准和数据消融上评估。 检查与停止：归因前必须固定三份文件、教师版本、去污染规则、消息序列化、优化设置和评测脚本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Same-backbone end-to-end result. AceMath-72B-Instruct, built on Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Base, averages 71.84 across seven math benchmarks under greedy decoding, versus 68.16 for Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct. The 7B AceMath model averages 67.17 versus 63.29 for the corresponding Qwen model, supporting the complete released curriculum while not isolating any single filtering decision.

Synthetic-data quality control. With Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the full AceMath recipe averages 64.19; removing all one million synthetic math samples lowers it to 62.53, while adding 500K lower-quality synthetic samples yields 62.95. This controlled result supports both useful prompt synthesis and selective filtering, but final-answer agreement and benchmark scores do not certify every reasoning step.

同底座端到端结果。以同一个七百二十亿参数数学基础模型为起点，AceMath 在七个数学基准的贪心解码平均分为 71.84，对应公开基线为 68.16。七十亿参数模型也从 63.29 提升到 67.17。该比较支持完整课程，但不能把增益只归因于某一个筛选环节。

合成数据质量控制。在同一个七十亿参数基础模型上，完整配方平均分为 64.19；删除全部一百万条合成数学样本后降到 62.53，额外加入五十万条低质量合成样本时为 62.95。结果同时支持题目合成与选择性过滤，但最终答案一致和基准得分仍不能验证每个推理步骤。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier math instruction releases often aggregate source answers or publish a single math-only mixture. AceMath changes the auditable object by releasing the exact general-before-math stages, regenerating responses into a common style, and separating broad prompt diversity from cross-model answer agreement used for high-quality subsets. Synthetic prompt evolution, SFT, and answer matching are not individually new; the direction signal is their staged composition plus controlled comparisons of synthetic quantity, filtering quality, and curriculum order. The release is therefore most novel as a reproducible data schedule, not as a new proof verifier.
较早的数学指令数据通常汇总原始答案，或只发布一份数学混合。AceMath 改变了可审计对象：它公开精确的先通用后数学阶段，把异构回答重写成统一风格，并把广泛题目多样性与高质量子集使用的跨模型答案一致性分开。合成题目、监督微调和答案匹配本身都不是新方法；方向信号来自这些方法的分阶段组合，以及对合成规模、过滤质量和课程顺序的受控比较。因此其主要新意是可复现的数据日程，而不是新的证明验证器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Cross-model agreement verifies only an extracted final answer; correlated teacher errors, invalid intermediate reasoning, and malformed proofs can remain. Recheck samples with independent solvers and step audits.
  • The public record schema is minimal and does not expose source, teacher, synthesis branch, filter decision, or overlap result per row. Reconstruct provenance before source-aware splitting or rights review.
  • CC-BY-NC-4.0, OpenAI output terms, and upstream dataset terms constrain reuse. Do not treat public download access as permission for commercial training or unrestricted redistribution.

• 跨模型一致只核对提取出的最终答案；教师可能产生相关错误，中间推理和证明格式也可能无效。复用前应使用独立求解器并抽查步骤。
  • 公共记录字段很精简，逐条数据没有来源、教师、合成分支、过滤决定或重合结果。按来源切分或审核权利前需要重建血缘。
  • 署名非商业许可、生成服务条款和上游数据条款共同限制使用。可公开下载不等于可以商业训练或无限制再分发。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use AceMath when the target experiment needs an explicit general-to-domain SFT schedule rather than a flat math mixture. Preserve the three split boundaries, independently verify a sample of teacher solutions, add source and transformation provenance, and compare full, no-synthetic, unfiltered-synthetic, and math-only variants at equal tokens. Success means the staged gain persists on decontaminated external benchmarks without a disproportionate loss in general instruction following; the release is unsuitable for commercial reuse without a separate rights determination.
当实验需要明确的通用到领域训练日程，而不是扁平数学混合时，可使用 AceMath。应保留三个阶段边界，独立验证教师解答样本，补充来源和变换血缘，并在相同词元预算下比较完整、无合成、未精选合成和纯数学方案。成功标准是分阶段收益能在外部去污染基准上保持，同时通用指令能力没有明显下降；未完成单独权利判断前，不适合商业复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The release is three stage files with 2,261,687, 1,634,573, and 1,661,094 rows, not one deduplicated 5.56M-example corpus.
  2. Math answers come from Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct, while GPT-4o-mini creates other responses and cross-checks selected math answers.
  3. About one million retained synthetic prompts use in-breadth and in-depth evolution; a noisy constraint-adding branch is excluded.
  4. Removing all synthetic data and adding low-quality synthetic data both reduce the same 7B consumer's seven-task average.
  5. Reuse requires per-row provenance, independent answer audits, decontamination refresh, and review of non-commercial and provider terms.

1. 发布对象是三份阶段文件，行数分别为 2,261,687、1,634,573 和 1,661,094，不是一份去重后的五百五十多万样本语料。
  2. 数学答案由强数学教师生成，其他回答和部分数学答案核对由另一教师完成。
  3. 约一百万道保留的合成题使用广度与深度演化，容易产生噪声的附加约束分支被排除。
  4. 删除全部合成数据或加入低质量合成数据，都会降低同一七十亿参数消费者的七任务平均分。
  5. 复用前需要补充逐条血缘、独立核对答案、更新去污染，并审核非商业许可和服务方条款。
